authority: User direction in this conversation; supersedes fragment-refinement-first scheduling, not historical verdicts.
objective: Minimum viable, scope-qualified NAMD model for each admitted experimentally established TT photoproduct isomer.

stereochemistry.inversion_verdict: chemical/numerical admission failure; not accepted equilibrium interconversion
stereochemistry.parameter_sharing: Unchanged, compatible parent terms may be reused; success of one isomer does not qualify another.

workflow: Inventory formation-supported isomers and existing usable assets; do not automatically run all eight registry entries.
Use an externally implemented parameterization workflow; verify its version and operation on a documented example before CPD fitting.
Prepare isolated canonical fixtures and complete NAMD topology/parameter exports.
Pass identity, coverage, charge, contacts, native energy/force loading, staged equilibration, restart and integration checks.
Run a finite NAMD feasibility panel and compare prespecified relevant observables with established references.
Freeze the provisional model for the tested scope, identify a specific substantial discrepancy, or close insufficient evidence.
mandatory_admission: Correct mapped connectivity and absolute stereochemistry
Complete compatible parameters and intended net charge
No invalid geometry or unphysical inversion
Native numerical stability and reproducible restart/integration

refinement_trigger.requires: NAMD evidence of a substantial departure from an established observable applicable to the tested isomer, chemistry and conditions; distinguish setup errors and sampling uncertainty first.
registration_before_comparison: Magnitude considered substantial and its scientific justification
refinement_trigger.if_reference_missing: Report provisional numerical qualification and validation gap; do not invent a reference or declare equivalence.
refinement_trigger.fragment_QM_mismatch_alone: Retained diagnostic limitation; not an automatic veto or reason for indefinite refinement.
refinement_trigger.exception: Bounded repairs needed to pass chemical or numerical admission remain necessary.

budget.scope: Shared ceiling, not48h per isomer; reconcile full ledger and register allocation before new native work.
budget.extensions: No automatic extensions; prior bounded stopping policy retained.

status: Policy registered; isomer roster, observable references and per-isomer budgets not yet admitted; no new native jobs.
